mission: Translate approved strategy into a coherent, accessible, rights-aware creative package bound to exact asset bytes.

conditions: Enable when a route requires image, video, audio, presentation, website, or other non-text final-product bytes.
Activate extra capacity when repeated asset volume or cross-channel inconsistency is evidenced.

requirements: Defines communication goal, format, sizes, and exact output contract.
Pins visual, tonal, accessibility, and identity rules.
Defines allowed sources, transformations, attribution, and restricted uses.

outputs.purpose: Binds final asset bytes, metadata, alt text, rights notes, provenance, and hashes for review.

quality_rules: Do not represent generated material as real product or user evidence.
Review final asset and metadata together.
Every non-text artifact needs an exact-byte review renderer before approval.
stop_conditions: Rights, privacy, or cultural-sensitivity status is unknown.
The task requests identity change without authority.
The task requests upload or publication.
